# Vendored pins.json fixtures

Compiler-produced ground truth, copied verbatim from `stc/examples/<name>/pins.json`
(the stc12c5a60s2-lab repo). These exist so the round-trip suite runs on any
machine, not only where the sibling repo happens to be checked out at ../stc.

Do NOT edit these by hand and do NOT regenerate them from this repo's own
output — their value is that the compiler side produced them. To refresh, copy
from the stc repo and say so in the commit message.
